data.name: Vyas
data.gender_notes: Vyas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who knows, the scholar, the sage, the teacher. The name Vyas carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Wise” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Vyas usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the knowledge of the universe and the divine truths, the one who has gained the ultimate wisdom and the highest understanding of the cosmos
data.etymology: Vyas belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vyas total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

celebrity_usage: Vyasa is the sage who is traditionally considered to be the author of the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Gita.
Vyasa is also known as Veda Vyasa because he is considered to be the compiler of the Vedas.
data.cultural_impact: Vyas is revered as the ultimate authority and the foremost divine sage in Hindu scriptures. He is considered the chief architect of the Mahabharata and the author of numerous other scriptures including the Vedas, the Puranas, and the 18 major Upanishads. Vyas is also known for his exceptional knowledge and wisdom. The name Vyas signifies a profound respect for intellectual pursuits and the role of scholars in preserving and transmitting sacred knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu philosophy, Vyas represents the divine consciousness or the highest Self, which is beyond all form, attributes, and manifestation. He is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom, and his name invokes the realization of the ultimate truth in one's own being. Vyas is also considered to be the embodiment of dharma or righteousness, and his teachings and guidance help individuals to live a virtuous and spiritual life, in accordance with cosmic law. Ultimately, the name Vyas serves as a reminder that the highest goal of human existence is to realize the inner Self and merge with the infinite divine consciousness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vyas is the divine sage and author of the great epics, Mahabharata and Bhagavad Gita. He is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom, personifying the power of the written word in preserving and transmitting sacred truths.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vyas is considered the author of the Mahabharata and the Vedas. The name Vyas carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Vyas is a revered figure in Hinduism and is considered the author of two of the most important texts in the Hindu tradition: the Mahabharata and the Vedas.

trends: Vyas is a popular name for boys in India
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Vyas remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Vyas, a teacher in Kathmandu, Nepal, shares that their name Vyas meaning "Knowledgeable, Wise" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
